behavior: Pipeline exposes explicitly profile-wide local rescoring and polls persisted scoring/preparation status until terminal, including reload recovery.

Scoring and preparation admission share the profile database lock, exclude active conflicting work, and reject distinct concurrent scoring requests. Exact request replay preserves terminal state even after profile changes.

Request identity is stored before POST; storage failure sends no request. Lost acknowledgement retries the same persisted identity after reload. Late profile responses and unavailable/malformed progress cannot enable preparation.

Connected Chromium journey starts with stale discovered fixture jobs, scores via the API/worker, prepares persisted resume and cover letter, downloads and verifies their hashes, opens the application and completes submit:false dry-run. Fresh Store/UI readback and fixture review=1/submit=0 prove saved outcome.
